name: @arena/network-quality-service
description: Arena network-quality reference service (Work Order C020; issue #126). Dispute intake/resolution, COI registration/checks and the anti-gaming + fraud detection jobs over @arena/network-quality: every command carries a REQUIRED idempotency key (lock rule 17) and replays recorded outcomes verbatim; disputes reference escalations, validation verdicts and payment records through the owning surfaces' PUBLIC ports (C009 validation-outcome source, C013 voting source, C010 payout-audit source, registry identity signals, C011 engagement signals) — never writes into dep state; reviewer COI is checked at the service boundary (a reviewer party to the dispute is excluded); detection jobs are idempotent per (tenant, scope) and never double-count; findings PROPOSE actions into the owning surfaces through the injected proposal sinks (profile evidence into the C005 ingestion ports — AQ-1; requalification triggers into C004); enforcement actions (HOLD/SUSPEND/INVESTIGATE) are explicit state transitions with append-only audit history; cross-tenant reads fail closed; tampered store entries fail closed on digest re-verification; deterministic under the injected clock (no hidden clocks).
